title: Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth

paragraphs.text: Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth is a four-part comic series published monthly by Dark Horse Comics starting in September 2025 . A paperback collecting all four comics was released on September 22, 2026.

Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth is an adaptation of an unpublished story from the Theros Beyond Death expansion . The series is written by Dan Watters ( Lucifer , Batman ) and illustrated by Owen Gieni ( Manifest Destiny , Rat Queens ). The creative team also includes colorist Hilary Jenkins and letterer Clayton Cowles. It is considered to be canon .

Although the complete background story for Theros Beyond Death had been finished by author Dan Wells in 2020 , there was no ebook published for Theros Beyond Death , nor were there weekly updates for Magic Story . It was revealed that the blowback from War of the Spark: Forsaken caused the Theros Beyond Death fiction to be delayed.

Elspeth is dead. But her story is not yet over. But Elspeth does not submit to despair — she emerges from each conflict a greater hero than before. And for a great hero like Elspeth, what is death but another challenge to overcome?

The sun god Heliod , having grown envious of his Champion , struck her down to the Underworld . There, she is forced to relive the worst moments of her life for all eternity. Suffering at the whim of Ashiok , she relives the trauma of her childhood , the betrayal by Helios, and the loss of Daxos . Meanwhile, the gods congregate: Heliod has gone too far and chosen the Returned Daxos of Meletis as his new Champion and has made him a Demigod . He sends Daxos to take over the temples of the other gods, competing with them for the devotion of the plane. While the gods are bickering, Elspeth stirs. She has become self-aware. She reaches into her nightmare , retrieves the Shadowspear and lodges it directly in Ashiok's chest. She is unimpressed by the Underworld, disappointed to not be in Ilysia or to have Daxos by her side. The gods have betrayed her once again and she is sick of it.

After slaying one god and being betrayed by another , Elspeth Tirel scours Theros’s underworld for the man she loved and lost . However, the god of fate plans to redirect Elspeth into a tragic destiny.
Defy the gods. Defy fate. Defy death.
Support for Elspeth grows in the Underworld, and the reluctant hero faces an Agent of Fate — the Nyxborn Calix .

Elspeth is dead. But her story was never over. Elspeth Tirel has faced nightmares and gods , and she has faced them unflinchingly. But in this series finale, can she face the man she once loved ? And can Elspeth truly defy death?
